questions.stem: Why does the stomach produce hydrochloric acid?

options.text: To break down carbohydrates into glucose
To provide the optimum acidic pH for pepsin and to kill harmful bacteria
To neutralise bile from the liver
To dissolve the food into liquid

questions.explanation: Hydrochloric acid in the stomach creates the acidic conditions (pH 2) needed for the protease enzyme pepsin to work, and it also kills bacteria that may have been ingested with food.
